text:
Real-estate teams obsess over cost per lead.

But most leads don't die in the ad. They die after the form.

Ad → form → call centre → branch sales → site visit.
Four handoffs. Each one is a delay. Each delay lets another builder reply first.

In this carousel:
→ Where the lead actually leaks
→ 3 fixes (instant reply, routing with a 15-minute alert, sending visits back to the ad platform)
→ The one number to report weekly: cost per site visit

If you run a sales team for projects in more than one location, swipe through and tell me which handoff hurts most.

Want this fixed in your business? WhatsApp me: +91 98131 36114
